feeds.title: Bohemian Bunnie
feeds.description: Andrea Whitt is an international touring and recording artist. Bohemian Bunnie was created from her passion for art, style and music. Painting since the age of two, and hoarding clothes since before she can remember, Bohemian Bunnie celebrates the intertwining of all of the arts.

feeds.title: Boho Weddings
feeds.description: Boho Weddings is a UK wedding blog celebrating all that is unique, unusual and alternative in the wedding world. Real weddings, DIY ideas, wedding planning, wedding advice and loads of wedding inspiration.

feeds.title: Erika Carlock
feeds.description: Hey, I'm Erika - writer of erikacarlock.com, and love of color and design! I'm addicted to exploring the world, finding the best spots, and sharing them with you. I share everything from interiors to travel, style favorites and recipes. Follow along as I share what's inspiring me in life!

feeds.title: Bohemian Bright Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Bohemian Bright, a travel + lifestyle blog that expresses my laid-back, whimsical spirit as well as my love for J.Crew and sun-filled spaces. Every aspect of travel makes me giddy, from discovering new places to the risks that come with unknown adventures to the hours of planning and organization that go into every trip.

feeds.title: Sancerres at Sunset
feeds.description: Sancerres at Sunset is a website all about cultural food and travel, sharing ideas, resources, and tips gleaned from decades of exploring the world, to help you plan your own fabulous adventures. Find helpful hints, background details and intriguing tidbits about history, art, architecture, and food in richly informative articles.

feeds.title: Mahiya Blog
feeds.description: Featuring photos from our latest collections, bohemian style tips, travel info, and more, the Mahiya Blog is ideal for boho babes from all walks of life. Mahiya is an Australian fashion label featuring bohemian handcrafted leather bags, wallets, accessories & clothing.

feeds.title: The Boho Diaries Blog
feeds.description: Lifestyle Blog by Nicki Odom. What started as an outlet to share my love of DIY flipping furniture projects, quickly evolved into a space where I share my style choices, DIY decor for the home and entertaining, as well as life momentos of parenting that I never want to forget.

feeds.title: Nicole Neissany Blog
feeds.description: When it comes to styling both fashion and home, my aesthetic can be described as neutral and minimalist, with a touch of boho, beachy flair. Aside from my obsession with aesthetically pleasing style, I crave adventure; I'm always discovering new places and sharing new experiences both near and far on my travel blog.

feeds.title: Dreamers and Lovers Blog
feeds.description: Get inspired by other bohemian brides. You'll find loads of wildflowers, flower crowns, yummy cakes, and lots of vintage-inspired, and simple wedding dresses. Every Dreamers & Lovers' dress is an art form, designed and handmade in our California Design Studio.

feeds.title: Melbelle Western X Boho Blog
feeds.description: Melbelle stands for curated discovery of western cowgirl and romantic bohemian styles. Our brand is built around a feeling of summer nostalgia and adventure. We aim to bring you beautiful western and bohemian inspired objects, fashion items and unique experiences so you too can enjoy a western lifestyle.

feeds.title: Ibizabohogirl
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to the world of Ibizabohogirl! My name is Yvon, a free-spirited boho girl born and raised in the Netherlands in the 70's. I am a dreamer, fashion enthusiast, travel lover, positive thinker, and creative soul.

feeds.title: Bohemian Traveler Blog
feeds.description: Stephen Bugno has been traveling, writing, and teaching English abroad for the better part of twenty years. His articles and essays have appeared in The San Francisco Chronicle, The Philadelphia Inquirer, The Seattle Times, and Transitions Abroad magazine. He blogs at Bohemian Traveler and edits the independent travel magazine.

feeds.title: The Modhemian Blog
feeds.description: An east coaster at heart, with new roots in Los Angeles and an unrelenting eye for bohemian design, The Modhemian has become an ever evolving outlet for sharing my idea of what is effortlessly chic, modern bohemian lifestyle design. The main goal is not only to make clean, comfortable, spaces accessible to my clients through interior styling and E-Design but to create an engaging platform for fellow creators, travelers and artisans to come and get inspired.

feeds.title: Be-Bohemian Blog
feeds.description: Bohemian fashion, lifestyle, culture, and ideology. Be~Bohemian is an online store offering a wide selection of bohemian clothing/ Boho Chic styles to help you exude the vibration between your style and your state of mind.

feeds.title: Gemzel Bohemian Lifestyle Blog
feeds.description: Find the latest accessory trends at the best prices in bohemian, antique & vintage styles! Fulfill your fashion dreams at Gemzel, complete your look and make a bold statement with our astonishing jewelry! Gemzel is a company whose vision is a world where everyone's basic needs are met - a world where everyone could expect to live healthy, happy and prosperous life.

feeds.title: Blushing Boho Design Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Michelle! I've been a full-time E-Designer since 2015, and have worked with over 1,000 clients to transform their spaces! I offer my services for very small scale projects, as well as whole home designs. I'd love to work together to create a space you love!

feeds.title: Boho Beautiful Blog
feeds.description: Boho Beautiful is a travel, yoga and lifestyle brand founded by Juliana Spicoluk and Mark Spicoluk creating positive content for the body, mind and earth. With content centered around yoga, travel, fitness, vegan food, self-awareness, conscious living and guided meditations.

feeds.title: White Bohemian Blog
feeds.description: Know the latest fashion, and home decorating ideas and be inspired by our boho babes' travel and lifestyle from our White Bohemian News. Since 2013, White Bohemian has been an oasis of free-spirited bohemian fashion, accessories, and homewares.

feeds.title: Bohemian Vagabond
feeds.description: Bohemian Vagabond is focused on solo female travels, off the beaten path destinations, local culture, ethnic food, and California life through the eyes of a cultural anthropologist.

feeds.title: Shabby Chic Boho
feeds.description: My name is Terri. This site was made with love as is everything I put my heart and soul into. I'm a seasoned blogger dating all the way back to 2001. I'm influenced by Downton Abbey, tea parties, real butter, made from scratch meals, homemade pies, chocolate-covered strawberries, and Green Mountain Breakfast Blend K-Cups coffee.
